messages:
anya: Hey team — need a compact micro-journey map + CTA variant tiles for the inbound webinar funnel. Goal: one social-sized graphic, one 800x600 slide tile, and a smaller shareable card. Also need localized copy for EN/DE/FR. Deadline: next Tues EOD. Can design take this?
sam: Yep, can do. Quick q: do you want the journey to include pricing/comparison callouts or keep it product-focused?
anya: Keep product-focused, highlight latency/cost wins + single-line CTA options (Watch Webinar / Try Demo / Read Bench). No pricing numbers.
sam: Got it. I'll propose 3 layout options: timeline, swimlane, and condensed flowcard. Which brand palette should I default to?
jordan: Use core brand palette (Blue-Primary, Gray-Text) + Accent-Chart for cost lines. Avoid heavy gradients. Follow the brand iconography rules — no heavy illustrations on small cards.
mike: For CTAs, provide micro-variants: 1) Watch webinar (primary) 2) Request demo 3) Read benchmark. I can write 2 headlines per CTA and 2 sublines to A/B test.
sam: Perfect. Specs I'll put in Figma:
```
- Social hero: 1200x628 (png + svg)
- Slide tile: 800x600 (pdf export)
- Share card: 600x400
- Font: Inter 600/400
- Color usage limit: 2 primary + 1 accent
```
anny: (typo) — anya: I'll upload approved hero copy in a sec. Also need alt text for each language for accessibility.
figma-bot: Figma file created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-webinar-journey-map — edit access: @sam @jordan @mike
sam: Thanks, saw the file. Will drop initial comps by Thu morning. Can someone confirm imagery? Do we want product screenshots or abstract shapes?
jordan: Abstract shapes please. If we need screenshots, they should be cropped to device masks and approved by product. Keep contrast high for legibility.
mike: I'll add the final copy variants into the figma notes: EN/DE/FR. DE may need shorter strings for the share card.
anya: Budget: this is for paid social + webinar landing. We need 3 alt creatives for social (rotate CTAs). Also include 1 static + 1 subtle-animated GIF variant if feasible.
sam: Animated GIF ok but small scope — I'll do a 3-frame micro-animation for social hero. Will need export guidance for size under 1MB.
jordan: Brand check: please ensure logo clearspace 8px, no drop shadows, and include org disclosure line: "Redwood Inference | Production-grade LLM inference" on slide tiles.
mike: For localization handoff, I'll provide a single CSV with copy_id, EN, DE, FR, alt_text fields. Can @sam confirm the copy_id keys?
sam: Yes — I'll add copy_id placeholders in Figma text layers. Mike, drop the CSV in the figma comments when ready.
anya: Timing recap — Thu morning comps, Fri internal review, Mon revisions, Tue final export. If anyone can't meet this, flag now.
sam: Onboard.
jordan: Onboard.
mike: Onboard.
anya: Great — thanks everyone. @figma-bot please ping when assets are exported. :thumbsup:
